programmes.d: An Alfa Romeo battles the thunderous Mercedes AMG C 63. And Henry Catchpole reviews the Boxster Spyder.
Dickie Meaden and Steve Sutcliffe race each other in i30 Ns. Then, explore the fascinating Col de Turini.
Find out if the 600LT is quicker than Porsche 911 GT3. Then, 2017's evo Car of the Year sets a lap time.
Test a modern reimagining of Subaru's iconic Impreza STI 22B. Then, get to know the cars of the evo team.
Harry Metcalfe shows off one of his favorites. Then, experience a Lamborghini Gallardo.
How does this fabulous M3 fare with power to all four wheels? Then, can this Lamborghini beat the McLaren P1?
Witness a supercar that Gordon Murray's had in his head for 25 years. Then, take a Cayman GT4 RS for a spin.
Put the last combustion-powered Lotus through its paces. Then, find out if the Ferrari 296 GTB thrills.
Join Adam Towler in adrenaline-pumping trips inside Subaru rally cars.
Is this generation of the Porsche 911 GT3 RS the ultimate track and road car? Then, test the McLaren 765LT.
Test the Ford GT, Porsche 911 GT2 RS, AMG GT R and Lotus Exige Cup 430 at the Anglesey Coastal Circuit.
Embark on a road trip across Europe to uncover the soul of this 912-bhp Audi.
Take a final spin with the Nissan GT-R NISMO. Then, witness a true test among analogue supercars.
The AWD shootout continues as evo decides whether AWD limits performance or takes cars to new heights!
Part 1 of the AWD test pits seven cars in a showdown at Anglesey Circuit!
Discover the Ferrari 296 Speciale! Then, Meaden races a Lotus Cortina in the fierce E2TC series!
Dive into the Porsche 911 R! Then, the 918 Spyder stuns with hybrid tech and thrilling performance!
Explore the Porsche 991! Then, see how Shell V-Power cleans engines and boosts performance!
Danny finds the perfect car- a 1966 Corvette Stingray. But can he convince the owner to let it go?

A couple from Miami enlists Danny and the Counts Kustom crew to raise money and awareness to combat a very rare disease. Meanwhile, Ryan and Shannon transform a valuable 1954 Harley Davidson Panhead motorcycle to its former glory.
It's an all-out blitz as Danny and the guys attempt to complete a 1961 Cadillac Coup de Ville in order to get not one, but two Counts Kustoms cars into the world's biggest auto trade show.

Danny and the guys take on a rare and valuable American street machine with big hopes for bringing it to this year's SEMA Convention in Las Vegas. Meanwhile, Shannon tries to tame a 500 horsepower Boss Hoss motorcycle.
Danny Koker restores a 1969 Shelby GT500 numbers-matching car from a rust bucket into an instant classic. The team visits the Detroit Autorama.
The massive auto extravaganza known as SEMA is rolling into Las Vegas, and this time Danny will be ready. He's getting not one, but two incredible Counts Kustoms creations ready for the big show.

Danny has big plans for a little street rocket known as a Manta, and the crew commissions an 80s era Corvette that the owner wants to bring into the new millennium. Shannon meets a motorcycle racer who wants her Harley XR1200 customized.

Steve wants to run his 1954 Oldsmobile in a thousand-mile road race. Dan faces a tight budget, a tough schedule and race rules. Jim wants Fantomworks to bring his 1977 Spitfire out of a coma; but Dan puts his foot down when safety issues are discovered.

When Gray brings his 1929 Phaeton in, Dan uncovers deadly dangers that lead to lifesaving repairs. Tony believes his 1989 Jeep Wrangler is 95% done, but the car is a rolling disaster of bad work, tangled wires and incompatible parts.

Emmett believes his 1964 Barracuda is all original. But Dan finds out that the car has hidden damage and a past that nobody expected. Velvet wants Dan to get her 1953 Studebaker Commander running as a surprise for her husband, Travis.

Brad wants a 1967 Mustang Coupe to be new again; so Dan has to fight the way the car was initially built by the factory. Jay wants a stunning 1965 TR4, but he plans to do most of the work himself. Instead, the Fantomworks side of the job keeps growing.

A 1917 Overland will be FantomWorks oldest restoration, if they can solve this jigsaw puzzle of rotted wood and rusted steel. Dan buys a 1968 Camaro on the internet for his wife, Malissa, and finds out that the car is in extremely poor condition.

The owner of a C10 pick-up wants a full frame off restoration and as Dan predicted, things get ugly when they peel off the paint. A Heinkel came in with mismatched scooter parts hiding an incredibly rare car - which makes parts almost impossible to find.

When the 1941 Buick Coupe rolls into FantomWorks, it is the worst possible combination: a very difficult car and very demanding owner. Janelle wants her KZ-750 transformed into a cool stripped down ‘café’ bike – a challenge for FantomWorks new bike shop.

Mike wants Dan to make his prized Mach 1 even more of a muscle car. Richard brings FantomWorks the first ‘his and hers’ restoration – a Sunbeam Tiger and a Fiat Spider – but as Dan soon discovers; the challenges of the two cars are not equal.
The Ferrari Purosangue shines with V12 power and agility. Then, the Subaru BRZ takes an epic road trip!
The Manthey GT3 RS pushes extremes as one of the wildest 911s ever, offering near-Cup car performance!
Meaden tests the new Ferrari F80 in Italy! Then, dive into the legendary Skyline GT-R R32!
Discover the Pagani Huayra's craftsmanship! Then, the Mégane 265 Cup goes against the SEAT León Cupra 280!
Catchpole shares a night drive in the Bentley GT Speed! Then, hit the track with the RS 6 Avant and VXR8!
Watch the BMW M3 battle the AMG C 63 S on track! Then, Catchpole recalls a McLaren road trip through Morocco!
Check out the Alpine A110's lightweight thrills. Then, dive into the Focus RS with its AWD punch!
Experience RM Sotheby's Ferrari auctions! Then, evo hits the 2013 Frankfurt show for standout cars!
